name: Baiyakuzumi ~Reijou Shimai~
source:
Four sister pass through a traffic incident and are sent to an island to recover by their father. Girls have good welcoming dinner and doze off... only to find themselves drugged in the basement with the biggest nightmare of their life approaching.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
四姐妹遭遇交通事故，被父亲送往孤岛疗伤。女孩们享用了丰盛的欢迎晚宴，然后打瞌睡……却发现自己在地下室被下了药，一生中最大的噩梦即将来临。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-june-2003-sayonara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
